$.Household.size.description: Number of people in the household.

$.Household.monthlyGrossIncome.description: Total monthly gross income for the household before any deductions.

$.Household.liquidResources.description: Value of countable liquid resources (cash, checking/savings accounts, etc.).

$.Household.monthlyHousingCosts.description: Total monthly housing costs including rent or mortgage plus utilities.

$.Household.isDestituteMigrant.description: True if the household includes a destitute migrant or seasonal farmworker. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(C))

$.Expedited.resourceLimit.description: Federal liquid resource ceiling for expedited SNAP: $100. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(A) and (C))

$.Expedited.grossIncomeLimit.description: Federal monthly gross income ceiling for prong 1: flat $150 regardless of household size. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(A))

Expedited.passesLowIncomeTest.description: Prong 1: monthly gross income below $150 AND liquid resources at or below $100. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(A))

Expedited.passesHousingCostTest.description: Prong 2: combined monthly gross income and liquid resources less than monthly housing costs. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(B))

Expedited.passesMigrantTest.description: Prong 3: destitute migrant or seasonal farmworker with liquid resources at or below $100. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii)(C))

Expedited.eligible.description: Eligible for expedited SNAP (7-day processing) if any one of the three federal prongs is met. (7 CFR 273.2(i)(1)(ii))
